basic_info.description: This is townhome living reimagined, meticulously crafted with entertaining in mind. This newly built townhome boasts a private elevator to all levels, private garage, and exclusive-use backyard in the picturesque Russian Hill neighborhood. Clean lines, the epitome of indoor/outdoor living, and an abundance of natural light set the tone for this home's overall design and modern aesthetic. The living, dining and kitchen space flow seamlessly together, include soaring ceilings, and create a dramatic open feel with high-end finishes throughout. The entertaining space features a wall of glass doors that open directly onto the private patio and exclusive landscaped backyard. The chef's kitchen is the perfect blend of style and functionality, showcasing a statement Caesarstone island and state-of-the-art Bertazzoni appliances. The upper level is home to two light-filled bedrooms with walk-in closets, spectacular bay views and two elegant en-suite bathrooms, featuring a walk-in, Porcelanosa rainfall shower and dual vanity. This level is complete with a home office and a spacious den, perfect for movie nights or a third bedroom. This home is complete with an additional powder room, radiant heat throughout, European Oak floors, two large storage closets, and elevator access to every level.
